semantics: Pre-registration contract. Values are filled ONLY at catalog freeze, sealed ONLY after the upstream chain reports CLOSED, and never edited after data contact. Hash-chained seals; the git history is the tamper evidence.

upstream_chain.blocker: sector attribution requires B6 physical BCs (mass guard fired: indefinite B on V4 branch)
negative kinetic channel, attribution pending B8/B6

mode_220.meaning: fundamental l=2,n=0 QNM, Re/Im in M-units

residue_hierarchy.meaning: mode-dependent excitation coefficients for the declared source model (frozen before data)

mass_scaling_law.meaning: declared scaling of the spectrum with M (must be fixed before the blind test; no post-hoc tuning)

falsification_bounds.meaning: per-quantity deviation from SSZ prediction that counts as falsification, frozen with the seal

mass_scaling_convention: omega is reported in units of 1/M_ref with M_ref declared at seal time; the blind test receives omega*M as the frozen target and may only convolve with DECLARED mass priors.

evaluation_protocol.step1_blind_test: frozen SSZ modes vs frozen observed catalog; scored jointly on f, tau, Q, relative amplitudes
evaluation_protocol.step2_ssz_vs_gr: same data, same noise model, same astrophysical priors; Bayes factor or information criterion + posterior predictive checks
evaluation_protocol.step3_out_of_sample: pipeline hash frozen after the development set; new events scored with UNCHANGED thresholds
evaluation_protocol.step4_multi_event: hierarchical p(theta_SSZ | d_1..d_N); dimensionless mode relations must hold across masses
evaluation_protocol.step5_cross_observable: photon ring, redshift, orbital frequencies, phase/JIF, timing — one geometry, many observables
evaluation_protocol.step6_adversarial: maximally attackable: un-fitted predictions (fixed mode ratios, extra damping branches, residue hierarchy, ring-structure relations)

outcome_semantics.robust_extra_predictions: declare new independent tests — NOT 'SSZ confirmed'
